hypothesis: A closed-bar BREAK of a live-engine LevelMemory level, followed by a RETEST of that level's zone within a bounded number of bars, then continuation in the break direction, has positive per-trade expectancy on real OPRA fills when exited via the live RIBBON_RIDE exit shape (both directions).

population.heldout_rule: held-out = last ceil(25%) of opra_days BY DATE, RECOMPUTED from the full amended 386-day list: ceil(0.25*386) = 97 days, 2026-03-03 .. 2026-07-22. Tune metrics (n, expectancy, total_pnl, day_wr, ex_top3, p_raw, gates 1-3) are computed on the 289 tune days (2025-01-02 .. 2026-03-02) ONLY. Heldout days are consumed exactly once, by the frozen 16-cell grid, to fill held_out_total / gate 4. No knob is chosen after seeing heldout output; no tuning of any kind occurs in this re-run (the grid is frozen).
population.heldout_boundary_shift_disclosure: v1 heldout was the inventory's frozen 96-day list (2026-02-25 .. 2026-07-17), computed before the 5-day OPRA amendment. Recomputing last-25% over 386 days moves the boundary 4 trading days later: 2026-02-25/02-26/02-27/03-02 move from v1-heldout into this run's tune segment, and the 5 amended July days join heldout. Additionally, v1 already evaluated the frozen grid once on the old heldout, so this re-run's heldout is not virgin data in the strict sense; with a frozen grid and immutable gates there is no selection channel through which that prior exposure can bias any knob, but it is disclosed.
population.level_context_days: all 386 covered days feed LevelMemory lookback context; signals are only evaluated on OPRA days
population.amended_days_disclosure: 5 days (2026-07-15, 07-16, 07-20, 07-21, 07-22) entered opra_days via the 2026-07-22 OPRA backfill amendment. The amendment note says their day_type/vix_band were not recomputed by the amender, but the on-disk inventory rows for all 5 DO carry day_type + vix_band tags (chop/range/trend, all vix_band=mid); those tags are used as-is for the disclosure splits.
population.untagged_days_disclosure: 5 days ARE untagged for day_type: 2025-01-02 .. 2025-01-08 (day_type='unclassified', classifier warmup at the start of the inventory). They carry vix_band tags and participate fully in signals/fills and the y2025h1 regime bucket; day_type is not used by any gate.
population.excluded_day: 2026-06-15 (12-bar RTH fragment) excluded upstream by the inventory; not in opra_days

timestamp_frame: et-v2 (pd.to_datetime(utc=True).tz_convert('America/New_York')) for BOTH spy_5m and OPRA caches -- same storage frame, so joins stay aligned; RTH = 09:30 <= t < 16:00 true ET

detector_fixed_rules.levels_source: backtest/lib/watchers/level_memory.py LevelMemory (the LIVE engine's multi-day level engine), RTH 5m bars, lookback_days=5 (module default), all engine constants untouched (SWING_HALF=2, CLUSTER_TOL=0.35, TOUCH_TOL=0.20, MIN_PIVOTS=2). No invented level sets.
detector_fixed_rules.level_set_at_break: levels_at(break_idx - 1): the level must pre-exist the break bar; its role is read BEFORE the break bar can flip it (causal, C6)
detector_fixed_rules.break_up: level role == 'resistance' at break_idx-1 AND close[break_idx] >= level + break_margin
detector_fixed_rules.break_down: level role == 'support' at break_idx-1 AND close[break_idx] <= level - break_margin
detector_fixed_rules.retest_zone: zone = [level - retest_band, level + retest_band] (zones, never penny-exact, per feedback_levels_are_zones). Touch = bar range intersects the zone, i.e. low <= level + band AND high >= level - band, in bars break_idx+1 .. break_idx+max_gap_bars
detector_fixed_rules.invalidation: episode dies if any bar in (break_idx, signal_idx] CLOSES back beyond the level on the ORIGIN side by >= break_margin (failed break); also dies on retest-window expiry or confirm-window expiry
detector_fixed_rules.confirm_touch: confirm='touch': signal bar = the first touch bar itself
detector_fixed_rules.confirm_close: confirm='close_confirm': signal bar = first bar in [touch_idx .. touch_idx+3] whose close is beyond the level in the break direction (close > level for up, close < level for down); the touch bar may confirm itself; window of 3 bars after touch is a FIXED constant
detector_fixed_rules.same_level_rearm: a new episode for a level within $0.35 (CLUSTER_TOL) of an unresolved episode's level cannot open until that episode resolves (entered or died)
detector_fixed_rules.same_bar_dedupe: if multiple episodes signal on the same bar, keep the one whose level has the highest memory_score (mirrors LevelMemory saliency)
detector_fixed_rules.signal_window_et: signal bar label in [09:30, 15:25] so entry fill bar starts within [09:35, 15:30] (live 09:35 entry gate; leaves >=2 bars before the 15:40 live time stop)
detector_fixed_rules.one_position_at_a_time: signals arriving while a walked position is still open are counted in n_signals but not filled (skip_reason='overlap') -- live engine is one-at-a-time

grid.rationale: break_margin 15c = the live LevelMemory BREAK_MARGIN itself; 30c = decisive-break variant. retest_band 10c = tight zone, 25c = wide zone (~TOUCH_TOL+5c). max_gap 6/12 bars = 30/60 min. confirm axis = J's entry-quality question (enter on the touch vs demand a directional close).

entry_fill_model.convention: option_pricing_real.py documented model: signal bar closes at label+5min; entry = next 5m OPRA bar (bar_at_or_after(signal_label+5min)) at that bar's VWAP
entry_fill_model.strike: ATM = round(spot at signal bar close) -- live truth for core Safe at $2K tier (crypto/lib/strike_selection.py V15_SAFE_TIERS offset 0)
entry_fill_model.qty_note: live minimum per Rule 6 (2 TP + 1 runner); RIBBON_RIDE tp1_qty_fraction 0.667 -> tp1_qty=2, runner=1

exit_model.engine: backtest/lib/exit_manager_walk.py walk_exit_manager -- the REAL live exit_manager.plan_exit_actions ticked over 5m OPRA bars. Entry-side tuning ONLY; no exit knob is in the grid.
exit_model.exit_shape: automation/state/fleet/strategies.py RIBBON_RIDE.exit.to_dict() verbatim: premium_stop_pct=-0.20, tp1_premium_pct=1.0, tp1_qty_fraction=0.667, profit_lock_mode='trailing', runner_target_pct=99.0, trail_pct=0.15, profit_lock_arm_pct=0.05, stop_mode='structure', catastrophe_stop_pct=-0.50, profit_lock_arm_scope='post_tp1'
exit_model.structure_stop_note: live params.json structure_stop_enabled=true as of registration; trigger_level = the BROKEN LEVEL price (the natural chart invalidation for break-retest: a closed 5m bar back through the level exits the position)
exit_model.ribbon: Saty Pivot Ribbon 13/20/48 (backtest/lib/ribbon.py, fingerprinted config) computed on the continuous RTH 5m close series across all covered days; ribbon_flip_back per walk convention (BULL stack flips a put, BEAR stack flips a call)

dollars.source: real OPRA fills only (backtest/data/options/ via option_pricing_real.py)
dollars.bs_synthetic: NONE -- episodes without a cached OPRA contract or without an entry bar are EXCLUDED from all gate math and disclosed per cell as n_signals - n_real_fills with skip reasons

per_cell_outputs.n_signals: confirmed entry signals on the segment's days (includes overlap-skips and no-OPRA skips)
per_cell_outputs.n_real_fills: signals actually walked on real OPRA bars (tune segment)
per_cell_outputs.expectancy: mean trade dollar P&L, tune segment
per_cell_outputs.total_pnl: sum of trade dollar P&L, tune segment
per_cell_outputs.day_wr: fraction of covered days (>=1 real fill, tune) with day P&L > 0
per_cell_outputs.ex_top3_total: tune total_pnl minus the 3 largest single-trade P&Ls
per_cell_outputs.held_out_total: sum of trade dollar P&L on the 96 heldout days (same frozen cell params)
per_cell_outputs.p_raw: one-sided sign-flip permutation test on tune per-trade P&L: 10000 resamples, seed 42, p = P(permuted total >= observed total)
per_cell_outputs.gates_passed: count of 4: (1) tune total_pnl > 0; (2) tune day_wr > 0.5; (3) tune total_pnl minus single best trade > 0; (4) held_out_total > 0

artifacts.runner_note: minimal extension of the committed v1 runner backtest/tools/edge_matrix_break_retest_continuation.py: same detector/walk/metric functions IMPORTED unchanged; new code only re-derives the heldout split, extends the levels cache incrementally to the 5 amended days, and adds the disclosure splits
artifacts.levels_cache: session scratchpad (intermediate only; recomputable from the runner)

causality_guards: level set for break detection is levels_at(break_idx-1) -- structurally cannot see the break bar
runtime truncation assert: on a sampled day, LevelMemory over the frame truncated at bar i must produce the identical (price, role) set as the full-frame levels_at(i) call
runtime ordering assert per episode: break_idx < touch_idx <= signal_idx and entry bar timestamp >= signal bar close time
honest_null_statement: A null (0 gates passed everywhere, or negative expectancy across the grid) is a valid and expected outcome and will be reported as such.
rerun_statement: FULL-HISTORY RE-RUN. The 16-cell grid, all detector fixed rules, the entry/exit model, and the immutable 4-gate ship bar are copied VERBATIM from the v1 prereg (rerun_of). Changing cells or gates on a re-run is methodology-shopping and disqualifies the run. ONLY the population changes: all 386 opra_days in the amended day inventory (v1 ran the pre-amendment 381).

regime_split_disclosure.purpose: DISCLOSURE ONLY (which regimes carry a result) -- NOT a gate. The 4-gate ship bar is unchanged from v1.
regime_split_disclosure.regime_split: per cell, over TUNE real fills: y2025h1 (date < 2025-07-01), y2025h2 (2025-07-01 <= date < 2026-01-01), y2026 (date >= 2026-01-01), each {n, total_pnl}
regime_split_disclosure.vix_band_split: per cell, over TUNE real fills, by the inventory's per-day vix_band tag (low/mid/elevated/high), each {n, total_pnl}
regime_split_disclosure.heldout_note: the heldout segment (2026-03-03 .. 2026-07-22) is entirely inside y2026 and is reported only via held_out_total / heldout_* fields
